sources: Google Maps: Big Spring River Camp, 501 Chicopee Rd, Van Buren (panel + newest reviews)

values.note: No posted rate (Facebook page only). RV Life campers report full-hookup motorhome nights at $40 (Aug 2025) and $50 (Jun 2026). Cash only (Google review, 2026).

fees.source: RV Life reviews for park 8750 (https://campgrounds.rvlife.com/api/reviews/park/8750): 'stayed 6/2026 | price $50 USD a night | Motorhome | pull_through | water yes sewer yes'; 'stayed 8/2025 | price $40 USD a night | Motorhome | site 36 pull_through', read 2026-11-07

note: Float-trip camp on the Current River just below the Van Buren bridge (not the NPS Big Spring), with full hookups and tube and cabin rentals; mostly seasonal campers, few overnight sites; cash only. CAMPER-REPORTED RATE: $40-50 a night (RV Life, 2025-26); call 573-323-8328. --Claude
summary: Facebook-only park that reviewers say has gone mostly seasonal ('only 1 site for overnighters', 2025); no posted rate; camper reports $40-50; Google 4.1 (99); riverfront stands for the front row. DROP CANDIDATE (long-stay / presence).
flags: DROP CANDIDATE (long-stay, mostly seasonal; I read it as mostly seasonal): RV Life review (stayed 6/2026, Motorhome, $50): 'Over the years it has transitions to mostly seasonal campers, but if you are lucky enough to get a transitional site'; RV Life review (stayed 8/2025, site 36, $40): 'There's only 1 site for overnighters.'; Google review (Mary Helen Hall, 5/5, a year ago): 'She mostly has seasonals, so if you are lucky enough to get a short stay spot, count yourself incredibly blessed.' Imagery shows ~45 RVs parked in rows with sheds/decks at many sites, consistent with seasonals.

FIVE LONG-STAY TESTS: (1) single nights sold - yes, by phone, cash only ('only accepts cash', Google, 4 months ago); (2) a nightly rate on the operator's own page - FAIL: no website, Facebook only, no posted rate; (3) open nights - not checkable, no booking engine; (4) 1 site in 10 sold nightly - FAIL on the 2025 report of a single overnight site among ~50; (5) what the operator leads with - the Facebook page leads with 'RV camping, tube trips and cabin rental', neutral. Two clear fails.

PRESENCE: no website - the stored website is the Facebook page (5,094 followers); Google lists it as 'Big Spring River Camp' (Campground, 4.1 from 99 reviews; Tripadvisor 3.7/5 from 15), phone (573) 323-8328 (matches stored), Google shows 'Add website'. Over 4.0 with 25+ reviews, so not a review drop on its own.

PRICE: camper reports only - $40 (8/2025), $45 (7/2024 travel trailer), $50 (6/2026); a $15 2024 report was a pass-holder figure. Under/at the US$50 line; written as reported fees with a CAMPER-REPORTED RATE note line (operator has no web page). gateways.py not needed below $50.

WATERFRONT riverfront stands (for the front row): imagery shows the riverside row of pads backing onto an open gravel bar that runs ~30-50 m to the Current River (here ~50-60 m wide, well over the creek line), with only scattered trees; reviews: 'Great sites on Current River ... Gravel beach allows swimming' (Tripadvisor), 'You have access to the river to swim' (RV Life 2025). Inner rows are *view at best.
PIN: stored 36.9877,-91.0082 (= Google's pin) sits on a house at the road junction ~150 m WNW of the RV rows' centre (~36.9873,-91.0066) - under the 250 m bound; optional move to 36.9873,-91.0066.
Hookups (derived from note prose) left as stored: reviewers report full hookups (power/water/sewer) at pull-through sites.
